abstract: During a distinguished career that spanned more than five decades, Assaf Razin, who passed away in July 2026, established himself as one of the leading international economists of his generation. This column describes how, across a range of topics including international trade, international finance, fiscal policy, taxation, migration, the welfare state, and financial crises, he combined theoretical innovation with an abiding concern for policy and for the ways in which globalisation expands national opportunities while constraining national choices.
abstract_zh: 在跨越五十余载的杰出学术生涯中，于2026年7月逝世的阿萨夫·拉津（Assaf Razin）奠定了其作为同代顶尖国际经济学家的地位。本专栏将阐述他如何在国际贸易、国际金融、财政政策、税收、移民、福利国家及金融危机等一系列议题中，将理论创新与对政策的持久关注相结合，并深入探讨全球化如何在拓展国家机遇的同时约束国家选择。
title: Assaf Razin: International economist for a global age

abstract: We propose methods to improve the forecasts from generalized autoregressive score (GAS) models (Creal, et al., 2013; Harvey, 2013) by localizing their parameters using decision trees and random forests. These methods avoid the curse of dimensionality faced by kernel-based approaches, and allow one to draw on information from multiple state variables simultaneously. We apply the new models to four distinct empirical analyses, and in all applications the proposed new methods significantly outperform the baseline GAS model. In our applications to stock return volatility and density prediction, the optimal GAS tree model reveals a leverage effect and a variance risk premium effect. Our study of stock-bond dependence finds evidence of a flight-to-quality effect in the optimal GAS forest forecasts, while our analysis of high-frequency trade durations uncovers a volume-volatility effect.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一些方法，通过决策树和随机森林对广义自回归得分（GAS）模型（Creal等，2013；Harvey，2013）的参数进行局部化处理，以改进其预测。这些方法避免了基于核方法所面临的维度灾难问题，并允许同时利用多个状态变量的信息。我们将新模型应用于四项不同的实证分析中，在所有应用中，所提出的新方法均显著优于基准GAS模型。在股票收益波动率和密度预测的应用中，最优GAS树模型揭示了杠杆效应和方差风险溢价效应。我们对股票-债券依赖性的研究发现，最优GAS森林预测中存在避险效应，而对高频交易持续时间的分析则揭示了成交量-波动率效应。
title: Generalized Autoregressive Score Trees and Forests

abstract: A continuing puzzle in constructing a point forecast by combining individual forecasts is that simple averaging often leads to a smaller out-of-sample mean square error compared to estimating optimal weights (the forecast combination puzzle). Most researchers have suggested that the puzzle is explained by estimation error in computing the weights, typically by estimation of a restricted least squares regression. For this explanation, gains from optimal weights must be small. This paper focuses on this complementary part of the argument and asks how large the gains from optimal combination can be in empirically and theoretically reasonable situations. Under these restrictions we show that gains can indeed be small, and that for gains to be large the best approach to forecast combination is to discard some of the forecasts and average over the remaining ones. We introduce a new weight estimation procedure implied by the theoretical results.
abstract_zh: 在通过组合个体预测构建点预测时，一个持续存在的谜团是，简单平均往往比估计最优权重产生更小的样本外均方误差（即预测组合之谜）。多数研究者认为，这一谜团可通过计算权重时的估计误差来解释，通常涉及受限最小二乘回归的估计。对于这一解释，最优权重带来的增益必须较小。本文聚焦于该论证的补充部分，探讨在经验上和理论上合理的情境下，最优组合的增益可能有多大。在这些限制条件下，我们证明增益确实可能很小，且要使增益显著，最佳预测组合策略是舍弃部分预测并对剩余预测取平均。我们根据理论结果提出了一种新的权重估计程序。
title: Combining Forecasts – On Why Averaging Beats Optimal Linear Weights
title_zh: 组合预测——论为何平均优于最优线性权重

abstract: This paper proposes a covariate-driven matrix factor model in which the row and column loading matrices evolve as nonparametric functions of an observable time-varying covariate sequence. This flexible specification accommodates dynamic factor loadings driven by the temporal characteristics of the covariate. We develop a nonparametric estimation procedure that combines kernel smoothing with principal component analysis (PCA). Under high-dimensional asymptotics, we establish convergence rates for the estimators of the latent factor, dynamic loading matrices, and common component. Furthermore, we propose a formal bootstrap-based hypothesis test for the null hypothesis of constant loadings and a post-estimation smoothing procedure to resolve rotational ambiguity. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications to international trade flows and portfolio returns demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method relative to conventional constant-loading matrix factor models, particularly in settings with complex, covariate-driven structural variation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种协变量驱动的矩阵因子模型，其中行和列的载荷矩阵作为可观测时变协变量序列的非参数函数而演化。这种灵活的设定能够适应由协变量的时间特征驱动的动态因子载荷。我们开发了一种结合核平滑与主成分分析（PCA）的非参数估计方法。在高维渐近框架下，我们建立了潜在因子、动态载荷矩阵及共同成分估计量的收敛速率。此外，我们提出了一种基于自助法的正式假设检验，用于检验载荷恒定的原假设，并引入了一种估计后平滑程序以解决旋转模糊性问题。蒙特卡洛模拟以及对国际贸易流量和投资组合收益的实证应用表明，相较于传统恒定载荷矩阵因子模型，所提方法在具有复杂、协变量驱动的结构变化情境中表现出更优的性能。
title: Dynamic Matrix Factor Models: A Covariate-Driven Approach to Varying Factor Loadings
title_zh: 动态矩阵因子模型：协变量驱动的时变因子载荷方法

abstract: Using monthly rainfall data, we study the demographic consequences of extreme rainfall variability, focusing on extreme dry and wet events in rural China. We find that both types of extreme rainfall events increase fertility, with a stronger response for male births, between 1990 and 1999. More than a decade later, children who were exposed to extreme rainfall events in utero, especially extreme wet events, attain fewer years of schooling than unexposed cohorts. The second trimester of pregnancy emerges as the critical exposure window, with shocks during this period generating the largest negative effects on adult educational outcomes. Examining potential mechanisms, we show that extreme rainfall events reduce household income and increase child mortality. These results highlight the persistent demographic impacts of extreme weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 利用月度降雨数据，我们研究了极端降雨变率的人口后果，重点关注中国农村地区的极端干旱和湿润事件。我们发现，在1990年至1999年间，这两类极端降雨事件均提高了生育率，其中对男性婴儿出生的影响更为显著。十多年后，那些在子宫内暴露于极端降雨事件（尤其是极端湿润事件）的儿童，其受教育年限少于未暴露的同龄群体。孕中期成为关键暴露窗口，此期间的冲击对成年后教育成果产生最大的负面影响。在探究潜在机制时，我们表明极端降雨事件减少了家庭收入并增加了儿童死亡率。这些结果凸显了极端天气冲击对人口结构的持久影响。

abstract: We examine how within-group inequality, by influencing the group bias of state institutions, affects the cost-benefit calculus of individuals engaging in identity-assertive behaviour, that results in police complaints regarding hate crimes. We develop a two-stage contest model of between-group conflict, where the relative influence of a group over institutions, determined by an initial contest, affects subsequent hierarchy-establishing interaction between individuals belonging to opposing groups. Applying this model to caste conflict in India, we find that greater inequality among non-Scheduled Caste and non-Scheduled Tribe (non-SC/ST) Hindus reduces the registered rate of crimes against SCs by non-SC/ST Hindus, and the rate at which such registered crimes lead to conviction. Using state-level annual crime and household consumption data over 2005–2021, we find empirical support for these hypotheses. Our analysis suggests that greater equality within dominant groups might reduce institution-capture by them and thereby improve both reporting and punishment of aggression against marginalized groups.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了群体内不平等如何通过影响国家机构的群体偏向，进而影响个体参与身份彰显行为的成本收益计算，此类行为最终导致针对仇恨犯罪的警方投诉。我们构建了一个两阶段群体间冲突的竞争模型，其中群体对机构相对影响力由初始竞争决定，并影响后续对立群体个体间确立等级关系的互动。将此模型应用于印度的种姓冲突，我们发现，非在册种姓与非在册部落（非SC/ST）印度教徒内部更大的不平等，降低了非SC/ST印度教徒对SC群体犯罪登记率，以及此类登记犯罪导致定罪的比率。利用2005年至2021年邦级年度犯罪和家庭消费数据，我们为这些假设找到了实证支持。我们的分析表明，主导群体内部更大的平等可能减少他们对机构的俘获，从而改善对边缘群体遭受侵犯行为的举报与惩罚。

title: Within-group inequality and caste-based crimes in India

abstract: This research examines the relationship between co-opted boards and firms' anti-takeover provisions (ATPs). Analyzing 5585 US firm-year observations for the period 2012–2022, we document a positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. We further illustrate that the positive relationship is stronger in firms that exhibit subpar performance and compensate senior executives and directors more than the industry average. Furthermore, our research finds that good governance, board and executive gender diversity, gender equality, and board cultural diversity moderate the positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. Our results remain robust across a battery of tests. The findings of this research have important implications for corporate boards and managers. The study contributes to the mainstream agency theory by demonstrating that co-opted boards exacerbate firms' agency problems by blocking the potential of external disciplinary mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同选择董事会与公司反收购条款（ATPs）之间的关系。通过分析2012至2022年间5585个美国公司年度观测数据，我们发现共同选择董事会与ATPs之间存在正相关关系。进一步研究表明，在业绩不佳且高管及董事薪酬高于行业平均水平的公司中，这种正相关关系更为显著。此外，我们的研究发现，良好的治理结构、董事会及高管性别多样性、性别平等以及董事会文化多样性能够缓和共同选择董事会与ATPs之间的正相关关系。我们的结果在多项测试中保持稳健。本研究的发现对董事会及管理层具有重要启示意义。该研究通过证明共同选择董事会通过阻碍外部纪律机制的潜在作用而加剧公司代理问题，为主流代理理论做出了贡献。
title: Co-opted boards and anti-takeover provisions in US firms: Do better financial outcomes and dynamic governance matter?

abstract: This paper compares the “mental maps” of redistribution among politicians and citizens across seven parliaments, using original in-person surveys of sitting MPs and nationally representative citizen samples. Fairness beliefs and ideology are the strongest correlates of support for redistribution in both groups, while misperceptions of wealth concentration matter for citizens but much less for politicians. A central finding is that politicians hold markedly more polarized views on redistribution than citizens, including within the same party families. We also find systematic elite-voter gaps: left MPs are more supportive than their voters (notably on inheritance taxation), whereas right/liberal MPs are less supportive than theirs. These patterns point to a representation concern and to a narrower bargaining space among elites than in the electorate.
abstract_zh: 本文通过对比七个议会中政治人物与公民关于再分配的“心智地图”，采用了针对现任议员的原创面对面调查及具有全国代表性的公民样本。公平信念与意识形态是两组群体中支持再分配的最强相关因素，而对财富集中度的误解对公民影响显著，但对政治人物影响较小。一个核心发现是，政治人物在再分配问题上的观点比公民更为极化，即便在同一政党家族内部也是如此。我们还发现了系统性的精英-选民差距：左翼议员比其选民更支持再分配（尤其在遗产税方面），而右翼/自由派议员则比其选民更不支持。这些模式指向了一个代表性关切，以及精英阶层内部的谈判空间比选民群体更为狭窄。

abstract: This paper estimates the cross‐sectional distribution of Epstein‐Zin preferences using the wealth and risky portfolio shares of a large panel of Swedish households. We find modestly heterogeneous risk aversion (standard deviation 0.97, median 7.50) and a meaningfully heterogeneous and right‐skewed time preference rate (TPR; standard deviation 7.31%, median 4.08%) and elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS; standard deviation 3.17, median 0.70). Risk aversion and the EIS are only very weakly negatively correlated. We estimate lower risk aversion for households with riskier labor income, and a higher TPR and lower EIS for households that enter our sample with low wealth.
abstract_zh: 本文利用瑞典家庭大样本的财富与风险资产组合份额，估计了Epstein-Zin偏好的横截面分布。研究发现：风险厌恶程度呈现适度异质性（标准差0.97，中位数7.50），而时间偏好率（TPR；标准差7.31%，中位数4.08%）与跨期替代弹性（EIS；标准差3.17，中位数0.70）则表现出显著的异质性与右偏分布特征。风险厌恶与EIS仅存在极弱的负相关关系。对于劳动收入风险较高的家庭，其风险厌恶程度较低；而初始财富水平较低的家庭则呈现更高的TPR与更低的EIS。
title: The Cross‐Section of Household Preferences
title_zh: 家庭偏好的横截面分析

abstract: How does demand uncertainty affect firms' investment decisions? We examine this question in the context of electricity‐producing firms' planned investments in new power plants. We measure uncertainty about future electricity demand using plausibly exogenous variation in temperature projections across scientific climate models. The results show that uncertainty increases investment in power plants with flexible production technologies, while reducing investment in less flexible technologies. Overall, the net effect of uncertainty on investment is positive when firms have access to flexible investment opportunities. These findings are consistent with models in which production flexibility shapes the investment response to demand uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 需求不确定性如何影响企业的投资决策？我们以电力生产企业对新电厂的投资计划为背景研究这一问题。利用不同科学气候模型对温度预测的外生差异，我们衡量了未来电力需求的不确定性。结果表明，不确定性增加了对采用灵活生产技术电厂的投资，同时减少了对灵活性较低技术的投资。总体而言，当企业拥有灵活的投资机会时，不确定性对投资的净效应为正。这些发现与生产灵活性决定投资对需求不确定性反应的模型一致。
title: Climate Change, Demand Uncertainty, and Firms' Investments: Evidence from Planned Power Plants
title_zh: 气候变化、需求不确定性与企业投资：来自计划发电厂的证据

abstract: Strengthening the ecological rule of law represents an important form of institutional innovation through which China seeks to achieve its carbon-reduction goals. Using a panel of 285 Chinese cities over the period 2006–2021, this study employs a supervised double machine learning framework to examine both the theoretical mechanisms and the policy effects of establishing environmental tribunals on urban pollution reduction and carbon mitigation. We find that the establishment of environmental tribunals significantly promotes coordinated reductions in pollution and carbon emissions at the city level. Mechanism analyses indicate that this effect operates primarily through the substitution and upgrading of clean industries, technological progress in energy conservation and emissions reduction, and the optimization of industrial land-use structure. Further heterogeneity analyses show that the mitigating effects are stronger in cities with more advanced judicial development, greater public awareness of legal rights protection, and more developed green finance systems. These findings suggest that the gradual expansion of environmental tribunals, together with continued improvements in industrial, technological, and land-use structures and the adoption of more targeted ecological rule-of-law policies tailored to local resource endowments, can enhance the synergistic effectiveness of pollution and carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 加强生态法治建设是中国实现碳减排目标的重要制度创新形式。本研究基于2006—2021年中国285个城市的面板数据，采用有监督的双重机器学习框架，考察设立环境法庭对城市减污降碳的理论机制与政策效应。研究发现，设立环境法庭显著促进了城市层面污染物与碳排放的协同减排。机制分析表明，该效应主要通过清洁产业替代升级、节能降碳技术进步以及工业用地结构优化三条路径实现。进一步异质性分析显示，在司法发展水平较高、公众法律维权意识较强以及绿色金融体系较完善的城市，其减排效应更为显著。研究结论表明，逐步扩大环境法庭的设立范围，持续优化产业、技术与用地结构，并因地制宜实施更具针对性的生态法治政策，能够有效提升减污降碳的协同效能。

abstract: This paper develops a novel production function framework that accounts for spatial spillovers in environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity and its components, namely technical change, scale efficiency change and environmental efficiency change, in a single‐stage setting, with greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions incorporated as an undesirable output. A parametric frontier model was specified to measure agricultural environmental efficiency and productivity growth, while allowing for the agricultural outputs to be functions of individuals’ and neighbors’ characteristics. The empirical application concerned the 126 prefectures in the Yangtze River Basin for the period 2000–2020. The empirical findings indicated an upward trend, with an average environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth rate of 0.213 during this period when spatial spillovers and agricultural undesirable output were considered, suggesting that agricultural productivity was increasing rapidly and at an accelerating pace. The downstream region experienced the highest rate of productivity improvement, followed by the midstream region, while the upstream region lagged. Technical progress emerged as the dominant driver of environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth in the study area.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新颖的生产函数框架，在单阶段设定中纳入环境调整后的农业全要素生产率及其组成部分（即技术变化、规模效率变化和环境效率变化）的空间溢出效应，并将温室气体排放作为非期望产出纳入模型。通过设定参数前沿模型，在允许农业产出受个体及邻近区域特征影响的前提下，测算了农业环境效率与生产率增长。实证研究以2000—2020年长江流域126个地级市为对象。结果表明，在考虑空间溢出效应和农业非期望产出时，该时期环境调整后的农业全要素生产率呈上升趋势，平均增长率为0.213，表明农业生产力正以加速态势快速提升。下游地区生产率改善幅度最大，中游地区次之，上游地区相对滞后。技术进步是研究区域环境调整后农业全要素生产率增长的主导驱动力。
title: Spatial Spillovers and Green Growth: Decoding Environment‐Adjusted Agricultural Productivity Dynamics
title_zh: 空间溢出与绿色增长：解码环境调整后的农业生产力动态

abstract: We study free banking with tokenized money and ask whether competition among private issuers can deliver efficient allocations in rollover economies with and without financial frictions. Issuers finance long-term investments by issuing par-redeemable, bearer-like tokens that must be rolled over at an intermediate date. In frictionless environments, Bertrand competition can implement the first-best, but the rollover channel depends on the competitive margin: competition in yields supports active secondary trade, whereas competition in issuance discounts forces issuer-managed rollover. When some issuers secretly abscond with funds, revealed absconding triggers default and exit, concentrating savings on surviving issuers and lowering aggregate rollover needs. This funds-concentration effect shifts equilibrium refinancing rates and redistributes returns across cohorts, so even investors who enter only after misconduct is revealed bear part of its consequences. Finally, we provide a new perspective on how regulatory restrictions on token remuneration can create inefficiency, instability, and potentially market breakdown.
abstract_zh: 本文研究代币化货币下的自由银行体系，探讨在存在与不存在金融摩擦的展期经济中，私人发行者之间的竞争能否实现有效配置。发行者通过发行以面值赎回、类似不记名形式的代币来为长期投资融资，这些代币必须在中间日期进行展期。在无摩擦环境中，伯特兰竞争可以实现最优配置，但展期渠道取决于竞争维度：收益率竞争支持活跃的二级市场交易，而发行折扣竞争则迫使发行者主导展期。当部分发行者秘密携款潜逃时，暴露的潜逃行为会引发违约和退出，从而将储蓄集中于幸存发行者，降低总体展期需求。这种资金集中效应会改变均衡再融资利率，并在不同代际间重新分配收益，因此即使在不当行为暴露后才进入市场的投资者也需承担部分后果。最后，本文为代币报酬的监管限制如何导致效率低下、不稳定乃至潜在市场崩溃提供了全新视角。
title: Free Banking with Tokenized Money
title_zh: 代币化货币下的自由银行体系

abstract: Protected areas cover 17% of the world’s land surface, yet credible evidence on their long-run economic and ecological impacts remains scarce. This paper estimates the effects of South Africa’s protected areas on household income, bird biodiversity, and tourism consumer surplus. For the income and biodiversity analyses, it develops a machine-learning counterfactual approach that recovers the present-day impacts of protected areas created up to 100 years ago. Short-run impacts of newer protected areas are small and statistically insignificant, while older protected areas generate large gains. Prior research may have severely underestimated the benefits of protected areas by only estimating the short-run effects of newly established protected areas. In aggregate, this paper estimates that protected areas increase annual household income by approximately R300 billion (roughly 10% of 2011 GDP). This yields approximately 7.6 million job-equivalents attributable to South Africa’s protected areas. Different types of protected areas play complementary roles in conserving different categories of threatened birds, demonstrating the value of South Africa’s entire protected area network. A structural travel cost model estimates that South Africa’s national parks generate R7.7 billion per year (2023 rand) in recreational value for domestic and international tourists. These results suggest that in South Africa there is little tradeoff between wildlife conservation and economic development. Realizing the economic and ecological benefits of protected areas, however, requires patience: returns to conservation accumulate over decades, not years.
abstract_zh: 保护区覆盖了全球17%的陆地面积，但关于其长期经济与生态影响的可信证据仍然匮乏。本文估算了南非保护区对家庭收入、鸟类生物多样性及旅游消费者剩余的影响。在收入与生物多样性分析中，本文开发了一种机器学习反事实方法，用以还原创建于100年前的保护区在当下的影响。较新保护区的短期影响较小且统计上不显著，而较老保护区则产生了巨大收益。此前研究可能因仅估算新设保护区的短期效应而严重低估了保护区的效益。总体而言，本文估算保护区每年使家庭收入增加约3000亿兰特（约占2011年GDP的10%），这相当于南非保护区创造了约760万个就业等效岗位。不同类型的保护区在保护不同类别受威胁鸟类方面发挥着互补作用，彰显了南非整个保护区网络的价值。结构性旅行成本模型估算显示，南非国家公园每年为国内外游客产生77亿兰特（2023年兰特币值）的游憩价值。这些结果表明，在南非，野生动物保护与经济发展之间几乎不存在权衡取舍。然而，实现保护区的经济与生态效益需要耐心：保护的回报需要数十年而非数年才能积累显现。

abstract: This paper develops an information design model to analyze how underwriters strategically disclose firm-specific information prior to equity issuance. The model predicts the existence of discriminatory disclosure: for high-quality firms, the disclosed offering price is positively correlated with firm fundamentals, whereas for low-quality firms, this correlation breaks down. Empirical evidence from China’s stock market under a market-oriented registration system supports this theoretical prediction, based on a proprietary dataset of IPO valuations sourced exclusively from underwriters’ internal pricing reports.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息设计模型，分析承销商在股权发行前如何策略性地披露企业特定信息。模型预测存在歧视性披露现象：对于高质量企业，披露的发行价格与企业基本面呈正相关；而对于低质量企业，这种相关性则不复存在。基于中国股票市场在市场化注册制下的实证证据，利用独家来源的承销商内部定价报告中的IPO估值数据集，验证了这一理论预测。

title: Information design and strategic disclosure in IPO underwriting
title_zh: IPO承销中的信息设计与策略性披露

abstract: This paper develops an evolutionary game model to analyze how economic incentives and social interactions influence household recycling behavior. Citizens are modeled as three types: non-recyclers, partial recyclers, and full recyclers, whose strategies evolve through imitation under bounded rationality. Individual payoffs depend on consumption benefits, a waste disposal tax on untreated waste, recycling costs and social interaction effects capturing similarity bias, moral motivation, and proselytism by environmentally responsible agents. The evolutionary dynamics are described by replicator dynamics, allowing us to characterize the existence and stability of multiple equilibria. Analytical results show that different population configurations may emerge, depending on the policy and social parameters. Numerical simulations further explore how variations in key parameters affect equilibrium selection and the basins of attraction of alternative outcomes. The results indicate that higher waste taxes and stronger social pressure increase the likelihood of convergence toward full recycling, whereas higher proselytism costs or stronger similarity bias can hinder the diffusion of pro-environmental behavior. These findings highlight the joint role of fiscal instruments and social dynamics in promoting sustainable waste management.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个演化博弈模型，分析经济激励与社会互动如何影响家庭回收行为。居民被划分为三类：非回收者、部分回收者和完全回收者，其策略在有限理性条件下通过模仿行为演化。个体收益取决于消费效用、对未处理垃圾征收的垃圾处置税、回收成本，以及反映相似性偏好、道德动机和环境责任者传教行为的社会互动效应。演化动态由复制者动力学描述，从而刻画多重均衡的存在性与稳定性。分析结果表明，根据政策与社会参数的不同，可能出现不同的人口配置。数值模拟进一步探讨了关键参数变化如何影响均衡选择及不同结果的吸引域。研究结果显示，更高的垃圾税和更强的社会压力会提高向完全回收状态收敛的可能性，而更高的传教成本或更强的相似性偏好则可能阻碍亲环境行为的扩散。这些发现凸显了财政工具与社会动态在促进可持续废弃物管理中的联合作用。
title: Recycling, waste tax and pro-environmental behaviors in an evolutionary game
title_zh: 进化博弈中的回收、垃圾税与亲环境行为

abstract: This paper examines how forced displacement shapes child development beyond socioeconomic disadvantage. The paper uses original data on roughly 1,600 Venezuelan refugees, Colombian internally displaced individuals, and nondisplaced children in Medellín, Colombia. The analysis adapts rank-rank regressions from the intergenerational mobility literature to a forced displacement setting, ranking each child’s developmental outcomes against household wealth. The paper documents substantial gaps that persist after holding wealth and parental background fixed. It also shows that the cause of displacement shapes the nature of the gaps. Venezuelan refugees displaced by acute material deprivation fall 19 and 13 rank points behind in cognitive and physical development, respectively. Colombian children displaced by armed conflict fall 12 rank points behind in depression and exhibit elevated trauma. Access to regularization and social services is associated with narrower gaps.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了被迫流离失所如何超越社会经济劣势影响儿童发展。研究基于哥伦比亚麦德林约1600名委内瑞拉难民、哥伦比亚国内流离失所者及非流离失所儿童的一手数据。分析将代际流动性文献中的排名-排名回归方法适配至被迫流离失所情境，依据家庭财富对每位儿童的发展成果进行排序。研究发现，在控制财富与父母背景后，发展差距依然显著存在。同时，流离失所的成因决定了差距的性质：因严重物质匮乏而流离失所的委内瑞拉难民儿童，其认知与身体发展分别落后19个和13个排名位次；因武装冲突而流离失所的哥伦比亚儿童，其抑郁指标落后12个排名位次，并表现出更高的创伤水平。获得合法身份与社会服务与缩小发展差距存在关联。

title: Consequences of Growing Up Displaced: Evidence from Displaced Children in Colombia
title_zh: 流离失所成长的后果：来自哥伦比亚流离失所儿童的证据

abstract: Insurance payouts, remittances, and government cash transfers all share one feature: they inject cash into local markets. While these interventions typically aim to improve the welfare of recipients, they can also affect the economic welfare of non-recipients. Yet our understanding of such economic spillover effects remains limited. Empirical studies report mixed findings, ranging from welfare-increasing to welfare-decreasing spillover effects, while the theoretical literature discussing potential mechanisms remains fragmented and lacks an integrated framework. This study develops a structured conceptual synthesis that integrates dispersed theoretical and empirical insights on the spillover effects of cash injections. We first develop a unified theoretical framework identifying the key mechanisms and moderating factors shaping spillovers, and then review the empirical literature through its lens. The framework highlights that spillover effects emerge through changes in local prices, wages, and resource sharing within social networks. We further show that the magnitude and direction of these effects depend on the interaction between cash-injection-specific parameters and the local environment, including its local economic structure and the constraints that recipient and non-recipient households face. By integrating insights across studies on cash transfers, remittances, and insurance programs, the paper provides a conceptual foundation for understanding spillover patterns of cash injections more broadly. Our analysis generates policy-relevant insights and highlights several important gaps in the current literature.
abstract_zh: 保险赔付、汇款和政府现金转移支付有一个共同特征：它们都向当地市场注入现金。尽管这些干预措施通常旨在改善受助者的福利，但也可能影响非受助者的经济福利。然而，我们对这种经济溢出效应的理解仍然有限。实证研究报告了从福利增加到福利减少的混合结果，而讨论潜在机制的理论文献仍然零散，缺乏一个整合框架。本研究构建了一个结构化的概念综合，整合了关于现金注入溢出效应的分散理论和实证见解。我们首先开发了一个统一的理论框架，识别形成溢出效应的关键机制和调节因素，然后通过该框架审视实证文献。该框架强调，溢出效应通过当地价格、工资以及社会网络内资源共享的变化而产生。我们进一步表明，这些效应的规模和方向取决于现金注入特定参数与当地环境（包括其经济结构以及受助和非受助家庭面临的约束）之间的相互作用。通过整合关于现金转移、汇款和保险项目的研究见解，本文为更广泛地理解现金注入的溢出模式提供了概念基础。我们的分析产生了政策相关的见解，并指出了当前文献中的几个重要空白。
title: When cash enters local markets: local economic spillover effects of cash transfers, remittances, and insurance
title_zh: 现金进入本地市场：现金转移、汇款与保险的本地经济溢出效应

abstract: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services. abstract_zh: 气候政策不确定性（CPU）冲击可引发资本从碳密集型部门向低排放部门重新配置。我们首先通过构建包含金融摩擦与多种气候政策工具的DSGE模型证明，CPU冲击会（i）降低"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的市值，并（ii）减少"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的实际投资。金融渠道在这一重新配置过程中发挥关键作用。其次，我们证实这些结论与美国企业层面的证据相吻合。实证研究发现，CPU冲击（i）导致金融市场对碳密集型行业企业的估值相对低于低排放行业企业，并（ii）引发显著的投资重新配置，尤其是从制造业向服务业的转移。
title: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
title_zh: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置

abstract: As populations age, a growing number of people need help with everyday activities. Long-term care can be provided by professional caregivers; however, the associated costs can lead to horizontal inequity, i.e. unequal access to care for individuals with similar needs. This paper examines income-related horizontal inequity in home care use in France, and the effects on horizontal inequity of the three funding systems involved: national health insurance, government allowances, and income tax deductions. Results reveal income-related inequities that favour wealthier individuals. Furthermore, while all three systems (including national health insurance) lead to horizontal inequity, we find that half of this inequity comes from home care provided by professionals funded directly by income tax deductions.
abstract_zh: 随着人口老龄化，越来越多的人需要在日常生活中获得帮助。长期护理可由专业护理人员提供，但相关成本可能导致横向不公平，即需求相似的个体在获取护理服务方面存在不平等。本文研究了法国家庭护理使用中与收入相关的横向不公平现象，并分析了三种相关资助体系——国家医疗保险、政府补贴和所得税减免——对横向不公平的影响。结果显示存在有利于富裕人群的收入相关不公平现象。此外，尽管这三种体系（包括国家医疗保险）均导致横向不公平，但我们发现其中一半的不公平源于由所得税减免直接资助的专业家庭护理服务。
title: Why care about who pays for care? Horizontal inequity in home care use for older adults
title_zh: 为何关心谁为照护买单？老年人居家照护使用的横向不公平

abstract: We study social security reforms in economies with segmented labor markets and pension systems. We develop a life‐cycle general equilibrium model with heterogeneous agents and endogenous retirement and sectoral choice across public, formal, and informal jobs. Calibrated to Brazil, the model shows that unifying pension systems and raising the minimum retirement age reduce the pension deficit by nearly 40 percent, while increasing output, capital accumulation, and welfare, despite redistributive effects across age groups, sectors, and along the transition path. Sectoral reallocation plays a central role in shaping reform effects, and ignoring these margins substantially underestimates the macroeconomic consequences of pension reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动力市场与养老金体系存在分割的经济体中实施社会保障改革的效果。我们构建了一个包含异质性主体、内生退休决策以及公共部门、正规部门与非正规部门间职业选择的生命周期一般均衡模型。基于巴西数据的校准结果显示：统一养老金体系并提高最低退休年龄可使养老金赤字降低近40%，同时提升产出、资本积累与社会福利水平——尽管这一过程伴随着不同年龄群体、不同部门以及转型路径上的再分配效应。部门间重新配置在塑造改革效果中发挥核心作用，若忽略这些调整维度，将显著低估养老金改革的宏观经济影响。
title: Social Security Reforms, Retirement, and Sectoral Decisions
title_zh: 社会保障改革、退休与部门决策

abstract: Using administrative data on the largest group of German labor market entrants - graduates from an apprenticeship in a specific occupation - this paper studies the effect of entry conditions on occupational mismatch. Higher entry unemployment entails persistent earnings losses driven by full-time wage effects. Concurrently, occupational matching falls, accounting for 20% of the wage effect. A framework shows that mismatch can arise from cyclical training firm retention or occupation-specific shocks, which I confirm empirically using novel data on occupation-specific unemployment. The findings highlight that specific skills protect graduates from unemployment but may expose them to costly occupational mismatch.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国最大规模劳动力市场新进入群体（特定职业学徒毕业生）的行政数据，研究进入条件对职业错配的影响。更高的进入期失业率会通过全职工资效应导致持续的收入损失。与此同时，职业匹配度下降，占工资效应的20%。一个分析框架表明，错配可能源于周期性培训企业留用或职业特定冲击，本文利用职业特定失业率的新数据对此进行了实证验证。研究结果强调，特定技能虽能保护毕业生免于失业，但可能使其面临代价高昂的职业错配。
title: When Skills Are Specific: Labor Market Entry and Occupational Mismatch for Apprenticeship Graduates
title_zh: 当技能具有特定性：学徒制毕业生的劳动力市场进入与职业错配

abstract: The transition to carbon-neutral residential heating poses extraordinary policy challenges to societies in Europe and beyond. In this paper, we study the electoral consequences of an amendment to the German Building Energy Act (GEG) aimed at phasing-out fossil-based heating systems. We use granular building stock data to approximate heterogeneity in household compliance costs and apply difference-in-differences and triple difference models to estimate its impacts on vote shares at the municipal level. For the state elections in Bavaria and Hesse, we find relative gains for the far-right (+2.4 pp) and conservative opposition parties (+6.5 pp) and losses for the incumbent federal government parties (−2.9 pp) in the baseline specification of our model. For the latter two, the effects are more pronounced in rural municipalities. These findings highlight the importance of holistic climate policy approaches that account for salient and heterogeneous costs to mitigate political backlash.
abstract_zh: 向碳中和住宅供暖的转型对欧洲及其他地区的社会构成了特殊的政策挑战。本文研究了德国《建筑能源法》（GEG）修正案（旨在逐步淘汰化石燃料供暖系统）的选举后果。我们利用精细的建筑存量数据来近似衡量家庭合规成本的异质性，并采用双重差分和三重差分模型，估算该修正案在市级层面对政党得票率的影响。在巴伐利亚和黑森州的州选举中，我们的基准模型结果显示，极右翼政党得票率相对上升2.4个百分点，保守派反对党得票率上升6.5个百分点，而联邦执政党得票率下降2.9个百分点。对于后两者而言，这种效应在农村地区更为显著。这些发现凸显了采取整体性气候政策方法的重要性，该方法需考虑显著且异质性的成本，以减轻政治反弹。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The Electoral Impact of Housing Climate Policy: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 住房气候政策的选举影响：来自德国的证据

abstract: Sustainable agricultural practices such as cover cropping can improve soil health, water quality, and carbon sequestration, yet U.S. adoption remains limited due to economic and operational barriers. We evaluate market and economic impacts of integrating perennial groundcover into U.S. corn and soybean production under six yield and cost scenarios. Results show that impacts depend on whether yields are maintained and costs remain stable. Under the most optimistic scenario, long‐term outcomes remain close to or slightly above baseline levels. In contrast, scenarios involving yield losses or sustained cost increases generate negative economic outcomes, highlighting the importance of agronomic performance and cost control.
abstract_zh: 覆盖种植等可持续农业实践能够改善土壤健康、水质和碳封存，但由于经济和操作障碍，美国对其采用仍然有限。我们评估了在六种产量和成本情景下，将多年生地被植物整合到美国玉米和大豆生产中的市场和经济效益。结果表明，影响取决于产量是否得以维持以及成本是否保持稳定。在最乐观的情景下，长期结果仍接近或略高于基准水平。相比之下，涉及产量损失或成本持续增加的情景则产生负面经济结果，凸显了农艺表现和成本控制的重要性。
title: Integrating Perennial Groundcover in Corn and Soybean Acres: Impacts on U.S. Agriculture
title_zh: 将多年生地被植物整合到玉米和大豆农田：对美国农业的影响

abstract: Long-term agricultural change in the United States is often described as a uniform process of crop simplification driven by modernization and specialization. However, the long-term regional pathways through which crop diversity has simplified or diversified remain poorly understood. We analyze county-level crop composition data from the U.S. Agricultural Census spanning 1840–2022 to examine long-term spatiotemporal changes in crop diversity. Given the multiple dimensions of crop diversity, we characterize crop diversity using compositional complexity, crop variety, and crop area evenness. These dimensions are examined using temporal breakpoint detection, spatial autocorrelation analysis, and unsupervised trajectory classification methods. National trends do not indicate consistent simplification across the three diversity dimensions but reveal a mid-twentieth century shift toward agricultural systems with fewer major crops and more even crop area shares. By contrast, at the county-level, crop diversity trajectories did not converge toward a single outcome. Instead, eight distinct integrated trajectory classes were identified: simplification pathways accounted for 63.72% of counties, while diversification pathways accounted for 36.28%. These pathways exhibit strong spatial structure, few intermediate outcomes, and long-lasting regional differentiation, suggesting path-dependent crop diversity dynamics shaped by historical specialization and spatial context. Our findings show that changes in U.S. crop diversity are temporally discontinuous, spatially divergent, and structurally complex. The integrated trajectory framework helps identify regional simplification and diversification pathways within agricultural land-use systems and provides a screening tool for regionally differentiated crop diversification policy.
abstract_zh: 美国长期农业变迁常被描述为由现代化与专业化驱动的作物简化统一过程。然而，作物多样性在长期区域路径上是如何简化或多样化的，至今仍知之甚少。我们利用美国农业普查中1840—2022年的县级作物组成数据，考察作物多样性的长期时空变化。鉴于作物多样性的多维特征，我们通过组成复杂性、作物种类和作物面积均匀度来刻画作物多样性。这些维度采用时间断点检测、空间自相关分析和无监督轨迹分类方法进行研究。全国趋势并未显示三个多样性维度上的一致简化，而是揭示了二十世纪中叶向主要作物减少、作物面积份额更均匀的农业系统的转变。相比之下，在县级层面，作物多样性轨迹并未收敛于单一结果。相反，识别出八种不同的综合轨迹类别：简化路径占63.72%的县，而多样化路径占36.28%。这些路径表现出强烈的空间结构、较少的中间结果以及持久的区域分化，表明受历史专业化和空间背景影响的路径依赖型作物多样性动态。我们的研究结果表明，美国作物多样性的变化在时间上不连续、空间上分化、结构上复杂。综合轨迹框架有助于识别农业土地利用系统中的区域简化与多样化路径，并为区域差异化的作物多样化政策提供筛选工具。
title: Divergent trajectories of crop simplification and diversification in the United States, 1840–2022
title_zh: 美国作物简化与多样化的分化轨迹（1840–2022）

abstract: In this paper, we develop a dynamic model of moral preferences in repeated public goods games on networks. We incorporate informational nudges and derive conditions for convergence of behavior and optimal targeting of policies. Importantly, the long-term impact of moral nudges on preferences and behavior depends on how preferences evolve. When preferences include a component of persistent intrinsic morality, the effect of a moral nudge dissipates over time. Conversely, if social preferences continuously evolve, influenced by recent periods and present experiences, the potential for long-lasting effects of behavioral interventions becomes more promising. We also discuss heterogeneous adaptation, which improves the model’s predictive power for laboratory public-goods experiments. With the framework constructed in this paper, outcomes in experimental, field and natural experiments can be evaluated to further understand what drives individual decision making.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个网络重复公共品博弈中的道德偏好动态模型。我们引入信息助推，推导出行为收敛与政策最优靶向的条件。重要的是，道德助推对偏好与行为的长期影响取决于偏好的演化方式。当偏好包含持久内在道德成分时，道德助推的效果会随时间消散。相反，若社会偏好持续演化，受近期阶段与当前经验影响，行为干预产生持久效应的可能性将更为乐观。我们还讨论了异质性适应问题，这提升了模型对实验室公共品实验的预测能力。借助本文构建的分析框架，可评估实验、实地实验与自然实验的结果，从而进一步理解个体决策的驱动因素。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Long-term morality effects of behavioral interventions in networks
title_zh: 网络中行为干预的长期道德效应

abstract: We examine how shocks to migration opportunities affect schooling outcomes in origin communities. We focus on the migration between Mexico and the United States, and exploit the expansion of the Secure Communities program in the US—a federal data-sharing program that substantially increased the risk of deportation for illegal migrants—as an exogenous shock to the attractiveness of illegal migration. Our results suggest that the Secure Communities program increased attendance, enrollment, and educational attainment in municipalities that had stronger migration-network links with counties in the US that adopted the program early-on relative to municipalities that had ties with US counties that introduced the policy somewhat later. These results are consistent with the interpretation that the Secure Communities program raised the returns to education for prospective migrants by making low-skill migration to the US less attractive.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了移民机会的冲击如何影响原籍社区的教育成果。本文聚焦于墨西哥与美国之间的移民流动，并利用美国“安全社区”计划的扩展——一项大幅增加非法移民遣返风险的联邦数据共享计划——作为非法移民吸引力的外生冲击。研究结果表明，相较于那些与美国较晚实施该政策的县有移民网络联系的市镇，与美国早期实施该政策的县有更强移民网络联系的市镇，其出勤率、入学率和教育成就均有所提高。这些结果与以下解释一致：“安全社区”计划通过降低低技能移民赴美的吸引力，提高了潜在移民的教育回报率。
title: Migration opportunities and human capital investments
title_zh: 迁移机会与人力资本投资

abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值

abstract: We present the first large-scale field experiment evaluating the integration of generative AI into a national justice system. In partnership with Pakistan's judiciary, we built JudgeGPT, a custom generative AI assistant designed for Pakistan's trial courts, and randomized 1,559 judges serving across 118 courts into one of three arms: (i) access to the assistant with targeted training tailored to its use; (ii) access to AI with generic training on technology and law; and (iii) generic training without access to AI. Judges who received AI access together with targeted training on the use of the tool were more likely to adopt it, use it more intensively, and continue using it over time. Their attitudes toward AI also shift: they expect the tool and the targeted training to increase their productivity. Administrative records move in the same direction: districts with greater exposure to treated judges resolve more cases. At median-district exposure, introducing AI with targeted training corresponds to 1,848 additional cases resolved per year, a 6.3 percent increase over the mean. This increase does not appear to come at the expense of reduced quality, as measured by case appeals (which slightly decline) or text-based measures of judicial writing (which slightly improve). Chat-log-based usage patterns suggest that judges use AI mainly to clarify legal concepts and support drafting. Targeted training appears to shift use toward tasks where language models are likely to be more useful, such as text improvement, and away from more open-ended legal queries where responses are more costly to verify. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI can raise public-sector productivity, but that these gains may depend on targeted training that directs use toward tasks for which the tool is better suited.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了首个大规模实地实验，评估将生成式人工智能整合进国家司法系统的效果。通过与巴基斯坦司法机构合作，我们构建了专为巴基斯坦初审法院设计的定制化生成式AI助手JudgeGPT，并将分布在118个法院的1559名法官随机分为三组：（i）获得AI助手并接受针对其使用的定向培训；（ii）获得AI助手并接受技术与法律通用培训；（iii）仅接受通用培训但无AI访问权限。结果显示，获得AI访问权限并接受定向培训的法官更倾向于采用该工具，使用频率更高且持续性更强。他们对AI的态度也发生转变：预期该工具及定向培训能提升自身工作效率。行政记录数据印证了这一趋势：接触过受训法官的地区案件处理量显著增加。在地区中位暴露水平下，引入AI并配合定向培训相当于每年多处理1848起案件，较均值提升6.3%。这种增长并未以质量下降为代价——案件上诉率（略有下降）和基于文本的司法文书质量指标（略有改善）均未出现负面变化。基于聊天日志的使用模式显示，法官主要利用AI澄清法律概念和辅助文书起草。定向培训促使使用行为从开放式法律咨询（此类回复验证成本较高）转向语言模型更擅长的任务（如文本优化）。总体而言，研究结果表明生成式AI能提升公共部门生产力，但这种提升可能取决于能否通过定向培训引导用户将工具应用于更适配的任务场景。
title: Courts of Tomorrow: Evidence from a Nationwide Rollout of Generative AI
title_zh: 明日法庭：生成式人工智能全国推广的证据

abstract: We study the long-run effects of a large public expansion of pre-primary education in Argentina. Between 1993 and 1999, the federal government financed the construction of new preschool classrooms targeted to departments with low baseline enrollment and high poverty, creating roughly 186,000 additional places. We link administrative records on classroom construction to four population censuses and estimate difference-in-differences models that compare treated and untreated cohorts across high- and low-construction departments. An additional preschool seat per child increases post-kindergarten schooling by about 0.5 years, raising the probability of completing secondary school by 11.9 percentage points and of attaining any post-secondary education by 7.1 percentage points. For women, access to the program also reduces fertility: an additional seat lowers the number of live births per woman by 0.20. Across several checks using cohort sizes, household composition, province-of-birth restrictions, and direct migration measures, we find little evidence consistent with systematic selective migration, suggesting that migration is unlikely to be a major source of bias in our estimates. Our results show little impact on labor-market outcomes at the census date, consistent with beneficiaries still being in school or in the early stages of their careers. A benefit-cost analysis based on the estimated schooling gains, standard Mincer returns, and observed construction and operating costs yields a benefit-cost ratio of about 11 and an internal rate of return of 13\%. Our findings show that universal at-scale pre-primary expansions in middle-income countries can generate sizable improvements in human capital and demographic outcomes at relatively low fiscal cost.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿根廷大规模公立学前教育扩张的长期效应。1993年至1999年间，联邦政府资助新建了针对基线入学率低且贫困程度高的地区的学前教育教室，新增约18.6万个学位。我们将教室建设的行政记录与四次人口普查数据相关联，采用双重差分模型比较高建设密度与低建设密度地区中受政策影响与未受影响的群体。每增加一个儿童学前教育学位，可使幼儿园后的受教育年限提高约0.5年，高中毕业概率提升11.9个百分点，接受高等教育的概率提升7.1个百分点。对女性而言，该政策还降低了生育率：每增加一个学位可使每位女性的活产数减少0.20。通过使用队列规模、家庭构成、出生省份限制及直接迁移指标等多项检验，我们未发现系统性选择性迁移的显著证据，表明迁移不太可能成为估计偏差的主要来源。结果显示，该政策在普查时点对劳动力市场影响甚微，这与受益者仍处于在校或职业生涯早期阶段的情况相符。基于估算的教育收益、标准明瑟回报率以及实际建设与运营成本进行的成本收益分析表明，收益成本比约为11，内部收益率为13%。本研究表明，中等收入国家大规模普及学前教育能以相对较低的财政成本显著提升人力资本与人口结构指标。
title: Long-run Effects of Universal Pre-Primary Education Expansion: Evidence from Argentina
title_zh: 普及学前教育扩张的长期效应：来自阿根廷的证据

abstract: Using employer-employee Italian data over the period 1998-2018 we analyze the impact of the largest regularization of undocumented immigrant workers in Italy on wage, employment and mobility outcomes of natives. Our empirical strategy takes advantage of the 2002 Bossi-Fini law that unexpectedly regularized 634,000 undocumented non-EU immigrants, with variation across firms and provinces that was not correlated with previous economic performance. We find that the policy had a small effect on the average wage of native workers and positive effects on their employment at the local labor market level. Additionally, native co-workers in firms more affected by the policy were more likely to change employers in the post-policy period. Such higher mobility resulted in a heterogeneous wage effect across switchers: workers that managed to transition towards better firms experienced wage gains in the medium- and long-run, while other workers experienced wage losses. This implied an increase in wage dispersion for natives and some losers among Italian workers.
abstract_zh: 基于1998-2018年意大利雇主-雇员匹配数据，本文分析了意大利最大规模非法移民合法化政策对本土劳动者工资、就业及流动性的影响。实证策略利用2002年《博西-菲尼法》意外合法化63.4万非欧盟非法移民这一准自然实验，通过企业与省份层面的变异识别政策效应，且该变异与地区前期经济表现无关。研究发现：该政策对本土劳动者平均工资影响较小，但在地方劳动力市场层面产生了正向就业效应；此外，受政策冲击较大的企业中，本土同事在政策实施后更可能更换雇主。这种高流动性导致流动者面临异质性工资效应：成功转向优质企业的劳动者在中长期获得工资增长，而其他流动者则遭受工资损失。这最终加剧了本土劳动者的工资离散度，并导致部分意大利劳动者成为政策受损方。
title: Immigrants' Regularization and Native Workers' Response
title_zh: 移民身份合法化与本土工人的反应

abstract: Quantifying spillovers from scientific knowledge to technology is important for understanding the social returns to science and for designing policy. A key challenge is how to credit scientific work with the value generated in downstream technologies when ideas diffuse through chains of follow-on research. We propose a new measure---Science Rank---that uses the combined patent and paper citation network to assign a share of the private value of patented inventions to the scientific papers they directly or indirectly rely on. Validated against various types of scientific awards, the measure substantially outperforms direct patent-to-paper citation counts in identifying influential science. We document large heterogeneity in spillovers across countries, disciplines, and institutions. The US emerges from our analysis as a powerhouse of science spillovers, benefiting both domestic and foreign technology development. We apply our methodology to examine how different countries and individual institutions contribute to innovation that addresses global challenges such as climate change or more equal economic development. We find that a relatively large share of the total value generated by research in Lower and Middle Income Country (LMIC) feeds into climate change related innovation. We also highlight countries and institutions that are making particular contributions to LMIC innovation.
abstract_zh: 量化科学知识向技术的溢出效应，对于理解科学的社会回报以及制定相关政策至关重要。当思想通过后续研究的链条传播时，如何将下游技术产生的价值归功于科学工作，是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种新指标——科学排名（Science Rank）——利用专利与论文的联合引用网络，将专利发明的私人价值份额分配给其直接或间接依赖的科学论文。经多种科学奖项验证，该指标在识别具有影响力的科学成果方面，显著优于直接的专利-论文引用计数。我们记录了不同国家、学科和机构之间溢出效应的巨大异质性。分析显示，美国是科学溢出的强国，其科学成果惠及国内外技术发展。我们应用该方法考察了不同国家和机构如何为应对气候变化或促进更公平经济发展等全球挑战的创新做出贡献。研究发现，中低收入国家（LMIC）研究产生的总价值中，有相对较大的一部分流向了与气候变化相关的创新。我们还重点指出了那些为LMIC创新做出特殊贡献的国家和机构。
title: Spillovers from Science
title_zh: 科学的溢出效应

abstract: We study the effects of taxi market deregulation in Finland, which removed price controls and lowered barriers to entry. The reform led to a surge in firm entry and a modest increase in exit, indicating substantial changes in market structure. Average taxi prices increased slightly according to price indices, while monthly firm-level reported sales and VAT declined by over 10 percent. Operating costs and mileage remained largely unchanged, suggesting limited demand responses. These findings point to increased tax evasion following deregulation. Consistent with this interpretation, we document a small rise in property crime, with no effects on other criminal offenses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了芬兰出租车市场放松管制的影响，该改革取消了价格控制并降低了市场准入门槛。改革导致企业大量进入市场，退出数量略有增加，表明市场结构发生了显著变化。根据价格指数，出租车平均价格小幅上涨，而企业月度报告销售额和增值税下降了超过10%。运营成本和行驶里程基本保持不变，表明需求反应有限。这些发现表明放松管制后逃税行为有所增加。与这一解释一致，我们记录了财产犯罪的小幅上升，而对其他刑事犯罪没有影响。
title: Taxi Market Deregulation: Effects on Market Outcomes, Tax Evasion and Crime
title_zh: 出租车市场放松管制：对市场结果、逃税和犯罪的影响

abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。
title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008

abstract: We derive tight pricing kernel restrictions from options with same‐day expiration (“0DTEs”). These restrictions concern the volatility of small and frequent asset price moves that the equity and options markets must agree on in a frictionless economy. Their violation leads to pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, characterized by nontrivial reward‐to‐risk ratios over arbitrarily short horizons and achieved by a combined position in 0DTEs and the underlying asset. Empirically, we find no evidence of feasible pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, as transaction costs, estimation risk, and short‐term volatility risk prevent investors from taking advantage of small and infrequent disagreements about volatility between equity and options markets.
abstract_zh: 我们从同日到期的期权（“0DTEs”）中推导出严格的价格核约束。这些约束涉及股票和期权市场在无摩擦经济中必须达成一致的小幅频繁资产价格波动的波动性。违反这些约束会导致伪套利机会，其特征是在任意短的时间范围内具有非平凡的收益风险比，并通过在0DTEs和标的资产中建立组合头寸来实现。实证上，我们没有发现可行的伪套利机会的证据，因为交易成本、估计风险和短期波动风险阻止了投资者利用股票与期权市场之间关于波动性的微小且不频繁的分歧。
title: Do Equity and Options Markets Agree about Volatility?
title_zh: 股票与期权市场在波动率上是否一致？

abstract: Property taxes, the primary source of local revenue for municipal governments, are essential for improving urban service provision and resident welfare. Yet this tax is widely unpopular and often politically contentiuous. This study's descriptive findings reveal that property owners are not currently motivated to pay their property taxes by the promise of collective benefits, but rather by the desire to secure their property rights. Thus, this study asks: What dimensions of property tax design do property owners prioritize? How do they negotiate trade-offs? And can policy design establish credible commitment? I address these questions using an experimental conjoint survey with over 2,000 property owners in 34 urban municipalities in Mexico. I find that property owners are largely indifferent to the progressivity of property tax increases yet strongly prioritize policies that enhance accountability in how government administers, spends, and enforces taxes. Specifically, the presence of active oversight strategies in the use of funds increases the support for a policy by 11 percentage points, an effect greater than that of policies that offer more direct benefits. Individuals with high perceptions of government corruption disproportionately favor tax policies that incorporate active transparency strategies even if this implies a higher fiscal burden. Overall, this study demonstrates that public support for property taxation is not entirely inelastic and that adopting accountability measures that signal how funds are spent can make property owners more accepting of tax increases. This study contributes to literature on the fiscal contract by demonstrating how policy designs that enhance accountability can help establish credible commitment.
abstract_zh: 财产税作为市政政府地方收入的主要来源，对于改善城市服务供给和居民福祉至关重要。然而，这一税种普遍不受欢迎，且常引发政治争议。本研究的描述性发现表明，业主目前并非因集体利益的承诺而缴纳财产税，而是出于保障自身产权的愿望。因此，本研究提出以下问题：业主优先关注财产税设计的哪些维度？他们如何权衡取舍？政策设计能否建立可信承诺？我通过在墨西哥34个城市市政区对超过2000名业主进行的实验性联合分析调查来解答这些问题。研究发现，业主对财产税增加的累进性基本不敏感，但强烈优先考虑增强政府在税收管理、支出和执行方面问责性的政策。具体而言，资金使用中积极监督策略的存在使政策支持率提高11个百分点，这一效果大于提供更直接利益的政策。对政府腐败感知较高的个体，即使这意味着更高的财政负担，也尤为倾向于支持包含积极透明策略的税收政策。总体而言，本研究证明公众对财产税的支持并非完全缺乏弹性，采取能表明资金使用方式的问责措施可使业主更易接受税收增加。本研究通过展示增强问责性的政策设计如何帮助建立可信承诺，为财政契约文献做出贡献。
title: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities
title_zh: 政策设计能否建立对地方税收的信任？墨西哥市政财产税的实验证据

abstract: We investigate the impact of gender composition on team performance in a real-world setting using a large-scale survey conducted within Chinese firms. We study the performance of two-person interviewer teams, with gender composition randomly assigned, tasked with complex survey data collection. Our analysis shows that two-female teams outperform both mixed-gender and two-male teams in interview completion and refusal-based questionnaire quality. Specifically, assignment to an all-female team increases the likelihood of completing an interview by 2.4%, and reduces refusals to answer key questions by 5%. This performance difference is likely driven by improved task coordination and a more favorable communication environment in all-female teams. This leads to increased effort input and ultimately enhances team effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们利用在中国企业内部开展的大规模调查，在真实情境中探究性别构成对团队绩效的影响。研究对象为随机分配性别组合的两人访谈员团队，其任务为完成复杂的调查数据采集工作。分析表明，全女性团队在访谈完成率和基于拒答的问卷质量方面均优于混合性别团队及全男性团队。具体而言，被分配至全女性团队可使访谈完成概率提升2.4%，并将关键问题拒答率降低5%。这一绩效差异很可能源于全女性团队中任务协调的改善与更有利的沟通环境，进而促使团队成员投入更多努力，最终提升团队效能。

title: “Girls with girls”: gender composition and team performance in survey data collection
title_zh: 女孩与女孩”：性别构成与调查数据采集中的团队绩效

abstract: We propose a robust bandwidth rule for the classical CUSUM and QS tests for shifts in the mean of a time series: the AR(1) coefficient entering Andrews’ (1991) data-driven HAC bandwidth is truncated at a fixed threshold $\rho {0} < 1$, with $\rho {0}$ selected by a simulation-based procedure that controls empirical size against a user-specified persistence robustness target. The truncated bandwidth is shown to be free from the asymptotic power reversal problem under the diverging-alternatives framework of Juhl and Xiao (2009). Monte Carlo evidence indicates that the CUSUM and QS tests implemented with this bandwidth deliver good size control and monotonic power across a range of break designs and persistence levels.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对时间序列均值突变检测中经典CUSUM和QS检验的稳健带宽规则：将Andrews（1991）数据驱动的HAC带宽中涉及的AR(1)系数截断在固定阈值$\rho {0} < 1$处，其中$\rho {0}$通过基于模拟的程序选择，该程序控制经验大小以针对用户指定的持久性稳健性目标。所提出的截断带宽被证明在Juhl和Xiao（2009）的发散备择框架下避免了渐近功效反转问题。蒙特卡洛证据表明，采用此带宽实施的CUSUM和QS检验在多种断点设计和持久性水平下均能提供良好的大小控制和单调功效。
title: Improved Andrews’ formula for testing changing mean
title_zh: 改进的Andrews变均值检验公式

abstract: Children who start school at a younger age are more likely to receive pharmacological treatment for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). This pattern is widely attributed to peer-comparison biases, but the relative importance of different underlying mechanisms remains debated. We use administrative data from England to study how school starting age affects ADHD prescription rates from ages 5 to 15. Exploiting a sharp school-entry cutoff and comparing children born just before and after September 1, we estimate both age- and grade-specific effects of early school entry. We find that early starters are 40–50% more likely to be treated for ADHD by age 15. This long-term gap is entirely driven by first-time prescriptions among children aged 5 to 8. Using a novel decomposition strategy, we isolate the roles of relative age, absolute age, the length of school exposure, and age at school entry. We find that relative age is the primary long-term driver, aligning with previous evidence on peer-comparison bias, while absolute age and the length of school exposure have only short-lived effects. Our findings suggest that early starters are more likely to receive marginal diagnoses due to their relative immaturity, and we recommend refining diagnostic guidelines and classroom grouping practices to reduce diagnostic gaps.
abstract_zh: 入学年龄较小的儿童更可能因注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）接受药物治疗。这一现象被广泛归因于同伴比较偏差，但不同潜在机制的重要性仍存争议。我们利用英格兰行政数据，研究入学年龄如何影响5至15岁儿童的ADHD处方率。通过利用严格的入学年龄截止日期，并比较9月1日前后的出生儿童，我们估算了早期入学对年龄和年级的特定影响。研究发现，早期入学儿童在15岁时接受ADHD治疗的可能性高出40%-50%。这一长期差距完全由5至8岁儿童的首次处方驱动。采用新的分解策略，我们分离了相对年龄、绝对年龄、在校时长及入学年龄的作用。结果表明，相对年龄是主要的长期驱动因素，与先前关于同伴比较偏差的证据一致，而绝对年龄和在校时长仅产生短期效应。我们的发现表明，早期入学儿童因相对不成熟更易获得边缘性诊断，并建议完善诊断指南和课堂分组实践以减少诊断差距。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Why are the youngest in class more often prescribed pharmacological treatment for ADHD?
title_zh: 为何班级中最年幼的学生更常被开具ADHD药物治疗？

abstract: Europe is converging on a definition of economic security as reduced dependence – de-risking, reshoring, buying European. This column argues that the definition is mistaken. Three decades of evidence on financial and production networks shows that resilience is a property of a node’s position in the network – the depth, diversity, and quality of its connections – not of the number of connections it has severed for self-sufficiency. Applying this test to critical input supply chains such as energy and defence – with Turkey, the EU’s largest customs union partner, as the defining case – the author argues that Europe passes the initiative’s ‘Singapore test’ only if it treats integration depth, rather than self-sufficiency, as the union’s security variable.
abstract_zh: 欧洲正在就经济安全的定义达成共识，即减少依赖——去风险、回流、购买欧洲产品。本文认为这一定义存在谬误。三十年来关于金融与生产网络的证据表明，韧性取决于节点在网络中的位置属性——其连接的深度、多样性和质量——而非为追求自给自足而切断的连接数量。作者以欧盟最大关税同盟伙伴土耳其作为典型案例，将这一检验标准应用于能源和国防等关键投入供应链，论证指出：只有当欧盟将一体化深度而非自给自足视为联盟的安全变量时，欧洲才能通过该倡议的"新加坡测试"。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为欧洲经济安全与供应链，不涉及中国
title: Resilience is a network property: Europe’s integration test for 2050
title_zh: 韧性是一种网络属性：欧洲2050年一体化考验

abstract: Nutrition insecurity remains a pressing global challenge, and while crop-livestock diversification offers a promising strategy to improve household nutrition, its relationship with micronutrient consumption remains underexplored. Using panel data from the Ethiopian Socio-economic Survey (ESS) from 2018/19 to 2021/22, this study examines the role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security in rural Ethiopia and explores the underlying pathways. Three aspects of farm production diversity are considered: crop-livestock diversification, crop diversification, and livestock diversification. The results indicate that crop-livestock, crop, and livestock diversification are positively associated with total and own-produced nutrient intake but negatively associated with nutrient intake from market-purchased foods. The findings further indicate that the nutritional benefits of diversification are generally stronger among households with better market access, while heterogeneity by shock exposure is more limited and nutrient-specific. The pathway analysis suggests that the relationship between crop-livestock diversification and nutrition outcomes operates through total food consumption, own-produced consumption, market-purchased consumption, farm output, and income channels. Among these channels, total food consumption and own-produced consumption represent the strongest channels, while the income channel appears comparatively weaker. These findings highlight an important nutritional trade-off: diversification is associated with greater nutrient acquisition from household production while reducing nutrient consumption from market-purchased foods. The findings suggest that policies supporting crop-livestock diversification, together with complementary nutrition-sensitive and market-supporting interventions, may contribute to improved household nutrition security while addressing production–market trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 营养不安全仍然是全球面临的紧迫挑战，尽管作物-牲畜多样化被视为改善农户营养状况的一项有前景的策略，但其与微量营养素摄入之间的关系尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2018/19至2021/22年埃塞俄比亚社会经济调查（ESS）的面板数据，考察了作物-牲畜多样化在埃塞俄比亚农村家庭营养安全中的作用，并探讨了其潜在的作用路径。研究考虑了农业生产多样性的三个方面：作物-牲畜多样化、作物多样化和牲畜多样化。结果表明，作物-牲畜、作物和牲畜多样化与总营养摄入及自产营养摄入呈正相关，但与从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入呈负相关。研究进一步发现，多样化的营养益处通常在市场准入条件较好的家庭中更为显著，而受冲击暴露的异质性影响较为有限且具有营养素特异性。路径分析表明，作物-牲畜多样化与营养结果之间的关系通过总食物消费、自产消费、市场购买消费、农业产出和收入渠道发挥作用。在这些渠道中，总食物消费和自产消费是最强的渠道，而收入渠道相对较弱。这些发现揭示了一个重要的营养权衡：多样化与从家庭生产中获取更多营养相关，同时减少了从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入。研究结果表明，支持作物-牲畜多样化的政策，辅以营养敏感型和市场支持型干预措施，可能有助于改善农户营养安全，同时应对生产与市场之间的权衡。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为埃塞俄比亚农村，非中国地区
title: The dual role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
title_zh: 作物-牲畜多样化在家庭营养安全中的双重作用：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据

abstract: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries, and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost-of-living inequality and long-run growth.
abstract_zh: 创新职业机会的不平等对创新方向与不平等有何影响？利用美国和芬兰的新型关联数据集，我们证实创新者更倾向于开发与其自身在性别、社会经济地位及年龄方面相似的消费者更可能购买的产品。这种同质性既存在于细分产品类别内部，也跨越不同行业，且近几十年来保持稳定。通过将这一"社会推动"渠道纳入增长模型，我们估算出创新职业机会的不平等对生活成本不平等及长期增长具有显著影响。
title: Social Push and the Direction of Innovation
title_zh: 社会推动与创新方向
